description: This Java class defines the response object for a 'ModifyPolicyEntry' command within the Eclipse Ditto project, handling JSON serialization/deserialization, and providing factory methods for creating instances with specific states.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyEntryResponse
classes.description: Response object for the 'ModifyPolicyEntry' command, handling JSON serialization/deserialization, and providing factory methods for creating instances with specific states.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating a policy entry was created, with deprecated overload accepting String policyId.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating a policy entry was modified, with overloads accepting String or PolicyId, and optional label.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JsonObject, deserializing the response.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this response.

methods.name: getPolicyEntryCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created PolicyEntry, if any.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the PolicyEntry as JSON, if present.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the resource, based on label.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.
